decisions.statement: A drop reaches the edits kept beside this agent's page.
A path is piped in as a line `at:` and that path, one path to a line.
A word on the command line other than the help flag is refused.
A flag other than the help flag is refused as any other word is.
The help flag is answered with what a drop does and what a drop takes.
The paths a drop takes away are piped in.
A drop piping nothing in is refused rather than taking every edit away.
A drop saying `all: true` reaches every edit that drop is over.
`all: true` said beside a path refuses the drop.
A path is read against the repository root.
A path naming no edit the drop reaches refuses the drop.
A drop names each edit that went.
A drop naming paths says how many edits are still kept.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.

definition: the command taking kept edits away without landing any of them
